title: One mapped-circle angular refinement kernel with caller-policy endpoint ordering
decision: Retain the angular-policy repairs and remove redundant map-level refinement interfaces and the duplicate fresh-refinement loop.

source.counting_note: The production prefix includes four deleted cfg(test) overlap-bracket forwarding methods outside conversion_tests; 16 removed functions were runtime code. No retained-object field is added.
source.public_api: unchanged; obsolete private/crate-internal forwarding methods are removed without compatibility aliases or shims
source.behavior: Simple mapped families use the common parameter API and one optional-seed bisection loop. Parallel refinement retains its provenance-safe incremental cache; overlap, similarity, and chamfer transports keep their exact specialized behavior. Pair, chord, overlap and selected-contact angular predicates receive the caller policy. Partial-overlap endpoint recognition uses that policy before choosing forward refinement rather than an antipodal inverse image. Retained chord tangent queries validate the caller's evidence policy.

regressions.original_production: Four final regressions fail; the seven existing checks pass. The original-production prefix is unchanged. Final regression helper and six angle-query test bodies are byte-identical in the matched control and candidate.
regressions.intermediate: Forwarding alone restored the pair/chord queries but exposed reversed overlap ordering at a terminal-resolved zero. Caller-policy endpoint recognition fixes the antipodal inverse path. The enclosure assertion checks the transported bracket rather than requiring nondyadic source refinement to produce an exact scalar.
regressions.final: All eleven focused checks pass, including both terminal-resolved endpoints, repeated strict replay, and forced-strict subpasses.
regressions.test_catalog: 916 tests in original, matched-original, and candidate catalogs. Measured workload bodies are byte-identical; the entire conversion_tests module is not claimed identical because callers of deleted private APIs migrate to the common parameter API.

no_default_features.ignored_coverage: all four opt-in cases pass in the full matrix

validation.prior_epoch: pre-lint-cleanup preserves the earlier passing full/minimal/UI tests and profiles. Both lint matrices rejected four redundant ignored-field patterns; those patterns were removed and all final gates were rerun. The first fuzz compile hit a read-only ccache in the sandbox; the approved escalated retry succeeded. Prior-epoch results are not final-source qualification or measurement evidence.

control.dependencies: Six repositories archived from fixed commits, without live dependency symlinks. Concurrent Hyperreal drafts remain excluded and untouched.
control.features: Unit controls use all features; native benches use the empty default feature set; UI/WASM uses UI defaults.
control.native_paths: Both revisions build in the same archived Hypercurve path. Executables are frozen before source changes.
control.heap_executable_names: Equal-length control-test and changed-test copies of matched-baseline-test and final-test.
control.cleanup: Only this run's completed scratch-check target cache was removed with approval, reclaiming 1.4 GiB. Sources, logs, recorded binaries, and earlier proof artifacts remain.

timings.protocol:
# Prespecified timing protocol

Run three alternating baseline/candidate pairs of five retained-kernel tests,
two native benchmark matrices, and three Boolean batch fixtures; then run seven
additional alternating pairs of both native matrices. Pin measured invocations
to CPU 7 after owned qualification/build/profile workers are terminal.

Retain every invocation and every lane, including costs. For each nontrivial
whole-process fixture within each matrix and binary, a max/min elapsed-time
ratio above 1.5 makes the latency comparison inconclusive. Do not select a
favorable subrange or retry. The mapped test may round to zero at the
centisecond process timer; its percentage is null, not a performance result.

Scheduling, desktop activity, frequency scaling, and thermal state remain
uncontrolled. Process/frequency snapshots are observations, not proof of
continuous isolation. Instruction and allocation traces are separate evidence
and their instrumented elapsed times are not latency measurements.
timings.caveat: All samples and lane costs are retained. No retry or favorable subrange selection. A mapped-test zero at the centisecond timer has no meaningful percentage; desktop load, scheduling, frequency and thermal state remain uncontrolled.

memory.scope: Complete, validated Heaptrack format-3 streams of whole-libtest invocations, with reconciled final live state. Not geometry-only accounting, process-wide RSS attribution, or an ecosystem leak claim.

milestone_status.exactcorelib_mining_and_recorded_uplift: already closed; no new milestone closure

limitations: This angular-kernel checkpoint does not establish universal performance or full release readiness.
Non-angular retained point/coordinate query policy paths and broader allocation coverage remain audit targets.
Concurrent Hyperreal changes are neither committed nor qualified here; integrate once the separate work is finalized.
No lower-stack or Hypermesh source change or fresh full-suite requalification in this slice.
No push, publication, deployment, fresh fuzz campaign, coverage run, or host configuration change.
followups: Profile any retained native lane costs; keep exactness and completeness ahead of lower-priority savings.
Rational equality still duplicates its existing exact PartialOrd dispatch and misses its leading-significand interval filter; evaluate delegation before adding machinery.
The one-item coarse-sign loop can be simplified separately while preserving its fallthrough to exact-fiber specialization.
Continue single-authority CurveRegion2 consolidation and the full release/completeness audit.
